integrity.coordinate_membership_basis: Each coordinate line is both a group translate of the empty-subset point and a direct limit of homogenized principal-minor vectors of diagonal symmetric matrices.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: Holtz--Sturmfels first submitted arXiv:math/0604374 on 2006-04-17 and introduced the complex algebraic image studied here.
integrity.fixed_locus_basis: A generic diagonal one-parameter subgroup has exactly the 2^n tensor coordinate lines as ambient fixed points.
integrity.invariance_basis: Oeding proves that Z_n is invariant under (SL(2)^n) semidirect S_n.
integrity.localization_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic of a complex algebraic C* variety equals that of its fixed locus; projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival Holtz--Sturmfels record lists AMS/MSC 14M12 first.

scientific_limitations: The novelty claim is restricted to n>=4; the n=3 hyperdeterminant case is prior-covered.
Only ordinary Euler characteristic and the compactly supported Euler characteristic of the projective complement are computed.
The complex projective variety is treated; real principal-minor images with inequality constraints are outside scope.
The localization proof is short, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed or folklore observation.
title: Euler characteristic of the projective variety of symmetric principal minors
